name: com.ticketwhistle/laliga-ticket-sales
title: TicketWhistle: LaLiga ticket sale dates
description: When tickets for the 20 LaLiga clubs go on sale, read from official club sites, with source links.

tools.name: upcoming_ticket_sales
tools.description: List ticket sale openings (members' sales, ballots, general sale) for LaLiga, Premier League and Serie A clubs, including their Champions League, Europa League and Conference League home games, read from official club websites, soonest first. Each item has the official source URL to cite. opens_at is ISO 8601 with offset; each item's 'timezone' is the club's local zone (Europe/Madrid, Europe/London or Europe/Rome).

competition.description: Only European games: UCL = Champions League, UEL = Europa League, UECL = Conference League

include_announced.description: Also return sales the club announced in the last 7 days that are open now

tools.name: get_club_ticket_windows
tools.description: When do tickets for a LaLiga, Premier League or Serie A club go on sale? Returns the club's upcoming and recent ticket sale windows with official source URLs, plus where to buy.

club.description: Club id or name, e.g. 'osasuna', 'Real Madrid', 'Arsenal', 'man-utd', 'Spurs', 'Juventus', 'inter'

tools.name: list_clubs
tools.description: List the LaLiga, Premier League and Serie A clubs TicketWhistle watches, with official ticket pages and how each is read.
